QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_20

question.text: An individual employed as a research analyst by a research entity shall NOT be subject to the supervision or control of:

answer.text: The head of the research department
The chief compliance officer of the entity
Any employee of the merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services divisions
The principal officer of the research entity

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 17(4) bars a research analyst from being subject to the supervision or control of employees of the merchant banking, investment banking, or brokerage services divisions. The rule protects the editorial independence of research from these business lines. The Trap: The regulation states what supervision is prohibited; it does not affirmatively certify particular roles (such as research department heads, compliance officers, or principal officers) as permitted supervisors, so any answer that frames the rule as a positive supervision list goes beyond the regulation itself. Note: Independence of research from banking / brokerage influence is one of the structural safeguards underlying the SEBI research-analyst framework.
